name: OpenVAS / Greenbone Community Edition
what: An open-source network vulnerability scanner with a web interface and a community feed of vulnerability tests.
when: For authenticated or unauthenticated vulnerability scans of servers and network devices when you have no commercial scanner.
cost_note: The Community Edition uses a community feed; Greenbone sells enterprise products and feeds.
example: Follow the Greenbone Community Containers guide to run the components with Docker Compose on a dedicated Linux host.
Wait for the feeds to sync, then sign in to the web interface.
Create a target with your approved IP ranges and, if possible, scan credentials.
Run a scan task, then sort results by severity and confirm each finding before you ticket it.
pitfalls: The first feed sync can take a long time; scans before it finishes miss checks.
Unauthenticated scans see far less than authenticated ones.
Scan production carefully and in agreed windows; some checks can upset fragile systems.
